steps.say: ahoy! add my project from {{projectOrigin}} as a local-only project called greeter. then ship one change to greeter: add greet.sh with three subcommands, hello, bye and version, each printing one line, plus a README section that documents them. one commit on its own branch. use the opus model for the worker. wait for my go before landing it.
one more thing for the greeter worker: greet.sh also needs a fourth subcommand, shout, that prints HELLO FROM THE CREW, documented in the README with the others. please pass that on to it now.
when the greeter worker is done, check that shout works, then land it on main; you have my approval. clean up and tell me after.
